Unown.text: This Pokémon is shaped like ancient writing. It is a mystery as to which came first, the ancient writings or the various Unown. Research into this topic is ongoing but nothing is known.

Dialga - Origin Forme.text: This Pokémon is revered as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Dialga was what caused the vast river of time to begin flowing in our world.

Palkia - Origin Forme.text: This Pokémon is feared as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Palkia was what caused the walls of our world to disappear, creating a sky that spans for infinity.

Keldeo - Resolute Form.text: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.

Cramorant - Gulping Form.text: It swallows prey whole and stores it in its expandable stomach, making its body heavier and more sluggish until it digests it.
